title: CLC2026 Synthetic Dairy Demand - HK PARKnSHOP (D1/D2/D3)
subtitle: Simulated store-SKU-week dairy demand on a 140-store x 120-SKU x 366-day grid, with three controlled variants (noise / realistic / planted) for a forecast recovery & retrieval experiment.
description: Synthetic dairy demand for the Corporate Link Challenge 2026. The real source data contain no sales; quantity is generated by generate_datasets.py from real explanatory inputs (price/promo, weather, calendar, store location, competitor proximity). Three independent variants share one grid (140 stores x 120 SKUs x 366 days): D1 = pure noise (i.i.d. Negative-Binomial at D2 marginals, 86.8% censoring), D2 = realistic log-linear demand surface calibrated to the USDA tonnage sanity band, D3 = D2 plus weak planted terms + a zero-effect spurious covariate. Files: dairy_weekly_d1d2d3.parquet (primary, ~890k rows), dairy_weekly_demo + dairy_daily_recovery (EDA / recovery subsets), sku_master.csv (SKU attributes incl. shelf life), and cleaned HK explanatory inputs. Use for practising forecasting, demand planning, and coefficient-recovery methodology. Compare variants only on aggregated metrics.
